summary: Since 2.3, become works on Windows via the runas method with the same settings, except become_user is required. It can bypass WinRM limits (delegation, WUA API) by becoming the same user, but the connection account must already be an Administrator.
questions: Can I use become on Windows hosts?
How can become help with WinRM restrictions?
Can a non-admin Windows user escalate with become?

answer_card.title: become on Windows
answer_card.answer_md:
Since 2.3, Windows supports `become` via **`runas`**, using the same variables, except **`become_user` is required** (no sensible default).

Becoming the same user as `ansible_user` bypasses WinRM limits like no credential delegation or blocked WUA API calls.

You can't escalate from an underprivileged account: the connection user must already be an **Administrator**.
